name: @ever-works/github-actions-runners-plugin
description: GitHub Actions self-hosted runners for Ever Works Fleet computers: the runner builds and their checksums, one-time registration and remove tokens, runners and jobs, through the Ever Works GitHub App

plugin.name: GitHub Actions runners
plugin.description: Turns computers of your Fleet into GitHub Actions self-hosted runners for repositories and organisations the Ever Works GitHub App is installed on: the runner builds and their checksums, one-time registration and remove tokens, runner status, queued and running jobs, and Cancel workflow run. It talks to GitHub with a short-lived installation token the platform mints for each call; it holds no credential of its own and never asks for a personal token.
